containers.name: job-ai-digital-office-db
args:
set -eu
export PGSSLMODE=require
export PGPASSWORD="$POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD"
escaped_password=$(printf '%s' "$ADO_APP_PASSWORD" | sed "s/'/''/g")
psql "host=psql-ai-digital-office-prod.postgres.database.azure.com port=5432 dbname=ai_digital_office user=ado_db_admin sslmode=require" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "DO \$\$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'ado_app') THEN CREATE ROLE ado_app WITH LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOINHERIT; END IF; END \$\$;" -c "ALTER ROLE ado_app PASSWORD '$escaped_password';" -c "GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE ai_digital_office TO ado_app;" -c "GRANT USAGE, CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO ado_app;" -c "ALTER SCHEMA public OWNER TO ado_app;" -c "ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT ALL ON TABLES TO ado_app;" -c "ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT ALL ON SEQUENCES TO ado_app;"
